assessment: The paper by Arribas et al. examines the coding properties of adult-born granule cells in the hippocampus at both the single cell and network level. This paper is of interest to the hippocampal and computational neuroscience fields because it provides a framework for understanding how adult-born granule cells in the hippocampus contribute to network processing. The paper contains interesting ideas, such as the analysis of input-output transformation by spike response models and the establishment of "greedy networks", and the conclusions drawn are supported by the data.
